summary: ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $9,800,000 of Class A ordinary shares under a sales agreement with Chaince Securities, LLC. The sales agent receives a 3.0% commission plus $0.02 per share. No escrow arrangement exists. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. The filing describes share classes, voting rights, and public float. There are no deal terms applicable; this is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4). Watch for ongoing dilution but no risk-arb angle.
